title: Your RC1 review, pages 10 to 44: routed to eight members
headline: Batches 5 to 9 are with their owners. Twenty-two rules now shape the book (T1 to T22), and fifteen tasks are out (A1 to A15). Meanwhile the team kept going: synthetic tested six candidate titles on its eight personas, the designer printed the lab at Crown Quarto and a trim study, the lab reached LAB 08, the researcher registered ten more of the talk's pieces, and the librarian mapped the index to every chapter.
